title: Replace deprecated datetime.utcnow() with timezone-aware datetime in superset/utils
body:
## Problem
`datetime.utcnow()` is deprecated as of Python 3.12 and returns a naive datetime, which is error-prone. It should be replaced with timezone-aware `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`.

## Scope (keep this minimal)
Limit the change to the `superset/utils` package, where there are three occurrences:
- `superset/utils/cache.py:76` — `dttm = datetime.utcnow().isoformat().split(".")[0]`
- `superset/utils/cache.py:229` — `content_changed_time = datetime.utcnow()`
- `superset/utils/dates.py:34` — `return datetime_to_epoch(datetime.utcnow())`

## Acceptance criteria
- Replace each `datetime.utcnow()` with `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` (import `timezone` where needed).
- Preserve existing behavior (e.g. `datetime_to_epoch` should compute the same epoch).
- No unrelated changes. Run the linters/formatters the repo uses for the touched files.
- Open a PR whose description includes `Closes #<this issue>`.

title: Use yaml.SafeLoader instead of yaml.Loader when parsing example metadata (Bandit B506)
body:
## Problem
`superset/examples/utils.py:261` loads YAML with the unsafe full `yaml.Loader`, which can construct arbitrary Python objects. Bandit flags this as **B506 (unsafe YAML load)** — note the existing `# noqa: S506` suppressing the warning.

```python
metadata = yaml.load(contents.get(METADATA_FILE_NAME, "{}"), Loader=yaml.Loader)  # noqa: S506
```

## Fix
The parsed content is simple metadata (a mapping). Switch to `yaml.SafeLoader`, which is sufficient here and removes the code-execution risk. Remove the now-unnecessary `# noqa: S506` if it is no longer needed.

## Acceptance criteria
- Use `yaml.safe_load(...)` or `yaml.load(..., Loader=yaml.SafeLoader)`.
- Confirm example import still works for the metadata shape used here.
- No unrelated changes. Open a PR whose description includes `Closes #<this issue>`.

title: Fix duplicated word "to to" in developer documentation
body:
## Problem
There is a duplicated word in the VSCode remote-debugging instructions:

`docs/user_docs_versioned_docs/version-6.0.0/contributing/howtos.mdx:422`
> ... VSCode will connect **to to** 127.0.0.1:5678 which is forwarded by kubectl ...

## Fix
Change "connect to to 127.0.0.1:5678" to "connect to 127.0.0.1:5678".

## Acceptance criteria
- Single, one-word edit on that line; no other changes.
- Open a PR whose description includes `Closes #<this issue>`.

title: Standardize "GitHub" capitalization in documentation
body:
## Problem
The project documentation refers to the platform as "Github" in a badge alt-text; the correct capitalization is "GitHub".

`docs/docs/index.mdx:30`
> `[![Latest Release on Github](...)]`

## Fix
Change `Latest Release on Github` to `Latest Release on GitHub` on that line. (URLs/paths that contain `github.com` must stay unchanged — only the human-readable label.)

## Acceptance criteria
- Only the alt-text label is changed; image/link URLs are untouched.
- Open a PR whose description includes `Closes #<this issue>`.
